text:
The Constitution and separation of powers
The US Constitution (1787) splits power between three branches that check each other:








Branch
Who
How they get there




Legislative
Congress: Senate (100) + House of Representatives (435)
Elected: senators for 6 years, representatives for 2


Executive
President
Elected every 4 years, at most two terms


Judicial
Supreme Court (9 justices)
Nominated by the president, confirmed by the Senate, serve for life

title: Star Schemas: Facts and Dimensions
text:
The idea
A star schema puts one big fact table (events you measure, like sales) in the middle, surrounded by small dimension tables (who, what, where, when).







Table
Example columns




fact_sales
date_id, product_id, store_id, quantity, revenue


dim_product
product_id, name, category, brand


dim_store
store_id, city, country


dim_date
date_id, day, month, year, is_holiday

title: Star Schemas: Facts and Dimensions
text:
A query
SELECT d.year, p.category, SUM(f.revenue) AS revenue
FROM fact_sales f
JOIN dim_date d    ON f.date_id = d.date_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY d.year, p.category;
